pyramiding_rule: No scaling into positions unless the initial trade demonstrates a minimum of +$3.00 floating profit and structural break of the prior candle high.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require confirmation via volume delta expansion and 3-period ATR volatility band rejection prior to market order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops once profit exceeds +$10.00 to capture tail runs up to +$30.00.
